title: The Judgment on Pharaoh and Egypt
description: The Lord sends a powerful judgment against Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, who is described as a great sea monster in the Nile. The prophecy warns that Egypt will become a desert for forty years, after which the Egyptians will be gathered again and become a humble kingdom in Pathros. Finally, the Lord gives Egypt as wages to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon for his service against Tyre [ref:Ezekiel 29:1-21|Ezekiel 29:1-21].
